summary.text:
US equity markets softened, with the S&P 500 falling 0.38% to 7520.93 and Nvidia dropping 5.47% to 168.89, while European indices posted modest gains. Market focus centers on shifting Federal Reserve interest rate forecasts from Goldman Sachs and artificial intelligence headlines, including Anthropic bankers preparing to raise its IPO valuation to $1.5tn.

The US dollar gained, pushing the DXY up 0.24% to 102.473, as EURUSD fell 0.72% to 1.1142 and GBPUSD dropped 0.91% to 1.3319. Commodities advanced across the board, with Brent crude rising 1.92% to 93.25, WTI gaining 1.24% to 87.11, and gold climbing 0.72% to 4059.10. Bitcoin traded slightly higher at 73939.07.

Looking ahead, investors are watching Nvidia's CEO scrutiny ahead of earnings, Nike’s upcoming investor day, Nissan's plans to counter Chinese competition after cutting its outlook, and developments around Spain’s first general strike in 14 years.
